projects.name: CDOT Ten Year Plan Project Lines (approved)
projects.notes: CDOT 10-Year Plan strategic pipeline projects as lines (ArcGIS Online item updated 2026-09, owner Planning_GIS_CDOT). planningprojectidstatus is the phase (see status_values); anything before construction is planned/in development. No cost or letting date in this layer. stip_id links to the STIP; projecttype is a second category field; route + milepoststart/milepostend locate it; adaptiveformtablewebsite is the project web page.

projects.name: CDOT Ten Year Plan Project Points (approved)
projects.notes: Point version of the 10-Year Plan projects; same schema.

projects_note: CDOT's own open-data server (dtdapps.codot.gov/server/rest/services/Webapps/open_data_sde/FeatureServer, layers 24 'Projects (all types) - Line' and 25 '- Point', listed on ArcGIS Online as updated 2026) could NOT be reached on 2026-11-16/17: connection timed out on every attempt (old host dtdapps.coloradodot.info gave HTTP 522). Not verified, so not recorded as a source; worth retrying because it probably carries all project types with cost and dates.
summary: CDOT 10-Year Plan line and point layers verified (phase and type, no cost or dates); CDOT's fuller 'Projects (all types)' server was unreachable. Parcels not yet researched.
